description: This file contains implementation of output formatting functions related to the curl tool, including functions for writing various transfer variables (like time, strings, long integers, offsets) to an output stream, and a main function 'ourWriteOut' that formats and writes custom data based on a user-specified template string. It interacts with libcurl's info APIs to retrieve transfer statistics and metadata, and supports JSON output and dynamic content substitution.

methods.name: int writeTime(FILE * stream,const struct writeoutvar * wovar,struct per_transfer * per,CURLcode per_result,bool use_json)
methods.description: Formats and writes a time variable from libcurl info to the output stream, in seconds and microseconds, optionally as JSON.

methods.name: int writeString(FILE * stream,const struct writeoutvar * wovar,struct per_transfer * per,CURLcode per_result,bool use_json)
methods.description: Retrieves and writes string information (like content type, URL parts, error messages) from libcurl info or internal data, supports JSON output.

methods.name: int writeLong(FILE * stream,const struct writeoutvar * wovar,struct per_transfer * per,CURLcode per_result,bool use_json)
methods.description: Retrieves and writes integer info (like HTTP code, header size, redirect count) from libcurl info or internal data, supports JSON output.

methods.name: int writeOffset(FILE * stream,const struct writeoutvar * wovar,struct per_transfer * per,CURLcode per_result,bool use_json)
methods.description: Retrieves and writes offset (size or byte count) info from libcurl info, supports JSON.

methods.name: void ourWriteOut(struct OperationConfig * config,struct per_transfer * per,CURLcode per_result)
methods.description: Main function that processes a user-specified format string with placeholders and outputs the corresponding transfer statistics and metadata, supports inline variable substitution and special constructs.

methods.name: int urlpart(struct per_transfer * per,writeoutid vid,const char ** contentp)
